canonical_data: agent session state, persistent session filesystems, and extracted long-term memory records
strengths: Runtime hosts CrewAI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and Strands agents, or no framework at all
Every session runs in a dedicated micro virtual machine that is terminated and sanitized when the session ends
Policy intercepts each tool call at the gateway against declarative rules before execution and logs every decision
weaknesses: The tool allowlist is not a containment boundary: it does not constrain the direct command-invocation API, so containment depends entirely on account permissions
Customer-managed encryption keys cover only memory and gateway resources, and gateway names, target names, tool names, and gateway logs are documented as unencrypted by default
The low-code harness path cannot use a framework of the customer's choice, and its export escape hatch produces one vendor's framework in one language
why_it_matters: The operated substrate beneath agents built in other frameworks, selling hosting, memory, tool governance, and tracing as a service rather than a library.
